title: set <ac> kind non-test leaves state computed, which is illegal for a non-test criterion
body: `intent set <ac> kind non-test` leaves the criterion's state `computed`, illegal for a non-test row, and only withdraw-then-reinstate moves it. Surfaced at the 3.0.1 cut. It is the re-kind half of the finding courses-vc reported on 2026-09-13 (a migration that wrote v2 non-test rows as kind test, filed beside this one): the flip has no verb that leaves a legal state behind. Carried in `intent/wip.md` until 2026-09-13.
